rows.details: Housing for All in Viksit Bharat: A Review of The Legal Framework and Procedural Bottlenecks to Optimise Affordable Housing in Delhi & Haryana
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA), full funding
Contractual for six months, further extendable subject to project requirements and performance

content_sections.heading: About NLU Delhi
content_sections.text: National Law University Delhi is a law university at Sector-14, Dwarka, New Delhi. According to the notice, it was established in 2008 on the initiative of the High Court of Delhi and the Govt. of NCT of Delhi. Since May 2026 the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs has recognised it as one of its Regional Centres to research on Urban Housing affairs. The project is a comprehensive legal mapping of the framework in which the housing ecosystem of Delhi and Haryana operates. It identifies legal and procedural bottlenecks through stakeholder consultations. Its stated objective is to help the Ministry and other policymakers improve access to affordable housing, especially for the socioeconomically weaker sections of society.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for one Research Associate on a contractual basis. The post table prints "Position: One (2)"; the text of the call and the figure "One" both point to a single post.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualifications: LL.M. with specialisation (preferably in Constitutional Law/Real Estate Law and Urban Development Law) from a recognised Indian or foreign university with minimum 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever a grading system is followed), and a good academic record. Demonstrable research work/publication and interest in urban studies, urban development and the law, constitutional law, local land and municipal laws, real estate, and other allied areas/themes. Desirable qualifications: Familiarity with quantitative and/or qualitative research methods, and the ability to assist in literature review, instrument development, data collection, data analysis and report writing. Proficiency in MS Office applications and data analysis tools. Prior experience in research projects. Proficiency in academic writing and ability to manage multiple tasks and meet timelines. The notice does not print an age limit. It is not specified in the notice whether any relaxation applies. For the full eligibility conditions, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly remuneration is ₹ 50,000/- per month. The appointment is contractual for six months and is further extendable subject to project requirements and performance. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or interaction. The notice states that the position shall lie with the Principal Investigator of the Project, or as may be decided by the University subsequently. The rules and regulations of National Law University Delhi apply to the selected candidate.

content_sections.heading: NLU Delhi Research Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: The Research Associate is expected to: Assist in research, review and analysis of statutes, policies, guidelines, regulatory frameworks and other available literature on the core and allied areas of the Project. Conduct doctrinal, empirical and comparative research (including literature review, case/document analysis and data-driven inquiries). Support the drafting of research outputs, including reports, briefs, research papers and internal working papers. Coordinate with project investigators and external consultants where required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NLU Delhi Research Associate
content_sections.text: Open the online application form at careers.nludelhi.ac.in, the address given in the notice. Prepare the six items the notice asks candidates to submit digitally, listed below. Submit the application through the online form by 20 November 2026, 23:59 Hrs. Physical or email applications will not be considered. Documents named in the notice: Cover Letter (200 words) Statement of Purpose (1000 words) Specialisation/Area of LL.M. Resume, including publications (if any) Writing Sample (sole-authored) Copy of PG Degree

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages. First, applications are screened for completeness and relevance. Candidates are shortlisted on an assessment of the application materials submitted through the online form. Second, shortlisted candidates are invited for an interview. Shortlisting does not guarantee an interview or selection, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. If a candidate hears nothing from the University within 2 weeks after the deadline, the application should be assumed unsuccessful. The interview date and mode are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Associate posts has NLU Delhi advertised?
faq.answer: NLU Delhi has advertised one Research Associate post on a contractual basis for the MoHUA-funded housing research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 20 November 2026, 23:59 Hrs (11.59 PM). Applications go through the online form only.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NLU Delhi Research Associate post?
faq.answer: An LL.M. with specialisation (preferably in Constitutional Law/Real Estate Law and Urban Development Law) from a recognised Indian or foreign university with minimum 55% marks or an equivalent grade, and a good academic record.

faq.question: Q4. What is the monthly remuneration?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is ₹ 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the application digitally through the online form at careers.nludelhi.ac.in. Physical or email applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents must be submitted?
faq.answer: A cover letter (200 words), a statement of purpose (1000 words), the specialisation/area of LL.M., a resume including publications (if any), a sole-authored writing sample and a copy of the PG degree.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Applications are screened for completeness and relevance, and shortlisted candidates are invited for an interview. Shortlisting does not guarantee an interview or selection.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is contractual for six months, further extendable subject to project requirements and performance.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or interaction.

faq.question: Q10. What if I get no call from the University?
faq.answer: If you do not hear from the University within 2 weeks after the deadline, the notice says to assume that your application has been unsuccessful.
